author: J. C. Kemp
title: All Byron Intermediate 3rd-graders participate in math section of 2024-25 MCA
text:
The Minnesota Department of Education reported Byron Intermediate School third-graders reached the highest participation level for the math section of the 2024-25 MCA.
Among 546 students at Byron Intermediate School who completed the math section, 172 were in third grade.
According to test standards, 78% of third-grade students demonstrated proficiency in mathematics.
The MCA and the Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) are statewide tests that assess student progress toward Minnesota’s academic standards and meet state and federal legislative requirements. Depending on grade, students take assessments in math, reading, and science. Most students take the MCA, while those receiving special education services who qualify can take the Alt MCA.
Proficiency rates on Minnesota’s MCA exams remain lower than they were before the pandemic , as detailed in Minnesota’s Report Card. For instance, math proficiency declined by over 7% compared to 2019, and reading decreased almost 5%.
